# nexus host get

List configured hosts, or show one

## Usage

```
nexus host get [NAME] [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  nexus host get
  nexus host get nas
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help            help for get
  -o, --output string   output format: table, json, jsonl or yaml (default table on a terminal, jsonl otherwise)
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```
